content: Marmot (Go) top-level packages: cfg, cluster, cmd, common, coordinator, db, encoding, grpc, hlc, id, notify, protocol, publisher, replica, telemetry, test; root marmot.go + shutdown.go. shutdown.go defines ShutdownOrchestrator: ordered graceful shutdown (mark self LEAVING -> set coordinator draining -> broadcast departure x2 -> stop listeners) with each step isolated via runStep so one failure does not abort the rest.
